input.prompt: Do trail #87 ("validate: keep the TS 7.1 oracle, retire the July harness") as ONE PR. Work in a new worktree off origin/main on branch `chore/oracle-only` (fetch first). Read $CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/validate-audit.md and the current apps/validate. Scope: (1) delete the July fixtures harness — compare.ts, analyze.ts, parity.ts, baseline.ts, run-ours.ts, run-react-docgen-typescript.ts, run-react-docgen.ts, run-semantic.ts, fixtures.ts, types.ts if nothing else uses it, bench-cold.sh, moon.yml — but first confirm nothing live imports them (grep apps/, scripts/, justfile, .github, package.json, docs); scripts/rdg.mjs already replaced run-react-docgen.ts. (2) Rename apps/validate to apps/oracle (git mv) and the package name accordingly; update scripts/weekly.py (it runs `pnpm --dir apps/validate exec tsx src/oracle.ts`), .github/workflows (weekly.yml, ci.yml comments), justfile ts_src/ts_src_only/ts_tests_only lists, pnpm-workspace.yaml, moon/other config, scripts/*.mjs/rdt/rdg resolution paths, docs references (docs/benchmarks.md, docs/type-checker-integration.md: keep the evidence table with a one-line note that the harness was removed, ARCHITECTURE/README/AGENTS mentions). (3) Trim package.json to what the oracle, tsx, scripts/rdt.mjs/rdg.mjs and CI actually need (RDT, react-docgen, typescript, tsx...) and regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml with `pnpm install --lockfile-only` then `--frozen-lockfile --lockfile-only`. Verify: the oracle test passes (pnpm --dir apps/oracle test or vitest as configured), `python3 scripts/weekly.py --bin <release binary> --corpus <one corpus> --corpora <dir> --oracle` still runs end to end on one corpus (corpora under $CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/bench-corpus may help), CI's CLI config tests still find tsx (`cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen --locked` or the exact CI command; read exit codes), `just lint doc-check typos`, actionlint/zizmor on changed workflows. Deliver: push the branch, then LINK THE TRAIL BEFORE opening the PR (Entire auto-creates a trail per PR and rejects a branch already owned by another): `entire trail link 87 --project gh/orin-dx --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper --branch chore/oracle-only`; confirm with `entire trail show 87 --project gh/orin-dx`; if a different auto trail already owns the branch, `entire trail unlink` it first, then link to 87 and report. Then `gh pr create` (non-draft, base main) titled e.g. 'chore: keep the TS 7.1 oracle and retire the July validate harness', short friendly body (what is deleted with line counts, what the rename touches, what you verified, the one cost: run-semantic.ts's 'does the TS algorithm still reproduce RDT on a new beta' check is gone), ending with https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED. Changeset: none (internal) — confirm against AGENTS.md. Coordination: another fork is doing docs/ADR work (branch docs/refresh-and-adr-pass); to avoid conflicts you own docs/benchmarks.md and docs/type-checker-integration.md edits; it owns the rest of docs/. Before pushing trial-merge (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) against every open PR head and origin/docs/refresh-and-adr-pass if it exists; if conflicting, resolve by stacking or narrowing. Rules: commits SIGNED (sandbox OFF for git; never --no-gpg-sign; verify %G? = G), ending `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED`; never force-push or merge; one plain git command per call; read exit codes directly; no hard-wrapping. Report: PR link, lines deleted/added, trail link confirmation, what you verified and what only CI can.
